name: Slack
description: Talk to her in Slack: her DMs, and the channels you choose when someone mentions her.
author: The Sara team

settings.label: Bot token
settings.tip: Starts with xoxb-. In your Slack app: Install App → Bot User OAuth Token. Kept encrypted in Sara's vault and never shown again.

settings.label: App-level token
settings.tip: Starts with xapp-. In your Slack app: Basic Information → App-Level Tokens, with the connections:write scope. It lets Sara connect out to Slack (Socket Mode); kept encrypted in Sara's vault.

settings.label: Send reminders and messages she starts to my Slack DM too
settings.tip: Her reminders also come to your DM with her in Slack. Never to channels or other people.
